entries.name: Financial Industry Business Ontology (selected finance modules)
entries.publisher: EDM Council; also standardized by OMG
entries.versionBasis: Official GitHub release API reports tag master_2026Q3, published_at 2026-10-20T20:02:05Z; archive returned gzip bytes. Quarter label is not publication date.

licence.basis: Tagged MIT licence permits use, copying, modification and distribution with copyright and permission notices. Imported ontologies and individual notices still require closure-level checking.

norn.overlap: Selected BE/FBC/LOAN modules are correspondence evidence; FIBO is finance-industry vocabulary, never SME accounting or Core authority.

priority.reason: Finance alignment ontology; MIT, so the OWL can be imported.

entries.notes: A historical LinkML title does not override the current SourceSchemaIR/profile direction. Preserve asserted/inferred distinction and unsupported axioms; recurrence does not establish equivalence. Redistribution: license-conditions.

entries.name: Financial Data Exchange (FDX) API
entries.versionBasis: financialdataexchange.org home page and the FDX Feed post 'FDX Announces Spring 2025 API Release – FDX API Version 6.4' (datePublished 2025-06-16), read live. No later release was announced on the public site.

licence.text: FDX API License Agreement (last modified 2026-07-15): limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable licence to use the API spec to build applications; no copying, modification, derivative works or distribution
licence.basis: Read the FDX API License Agreement PDF (financialdataexchange.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/...July-15-2026...pdf), linked from the FDX home page, today: sections 1 (grant) and 2 (use restrictions 2.1 to 2.4).

norn.overlap: consumer-permissioned account, transaction, statement and payment-network data sharing

priority.reason: Money and instrument identity underpin every ledger.

entries.notes: FDX says it releases twice a year, so a member-only release newer than 6.4 may exist. The spec hub page rendered empty to the fetcher. Access is under a click-through licence.

entries.name: ISO 4217 current currency and funds codes (SIX List One)
entries.publisher: SIX Financial Information, ISO 4217 Maintenance Agency
entries.versionBasis: Fetched XML root ISO_4217 has Pblshd=2026-09-17. No separately numbered release asserted.

licence.basis: No licence notice in inspected XML and no artifact-specific redistribution/derivative grant established from SIX pages. Official/free access is not an open licence.

norn.overlap: Currency identifier and minor-unit reference for Money values; no FX rate or permission to override explicit monetary precision.

priority.reason: Every money amount carries an ISO 4217 currency.

entries.notes: Do not use a third-party CC0/MIT repackaging to infer rights in the official XML. Preserve special nonnumeric minor-unit values as published. Redistribution: unverified.

entries.name: ISO 4217 historical currency and funds codes (SIX List Three)
entries.publisher: SIX Financial Information, ISO 4217 Maintenance Agency
entries.versionBasis: Fetched XML root ISO_4217 has Pblshd=2026-01-01, distinct from List One's 2026-09-17. No inferred synchronized release.

licence.basis: No verified open redistribution or derivative grant for this official XML. Rights must be established separately from the fact it downloads publicly.

norn.overlap: Historical currency codes and withdrawal periods preserve financial-record interpretation; never discard retired identifiers.

priority.reason: Historic currencies keep old ledgers valid.

entries.notes: Withdrawal dates can have month/range precision; do not invent day-level validity or remove withdrawn records. The clock does not determine the source release date. Redistribution: unverified.
